subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Flat Engine
description: A quick win: understand The Flat Engine.

hook.text: Lay the cylinders flat so they face each other horizontally and you get a boxer engine.

buildup.text: Opposing pistons punch toward each other and cancel vibrations with every stroke.

discovery.text: Porsche and Subaru built their identities around flat engines for the low center of gravity.

twist.text: A flat engine sits low in the chassis, dropping the center of mass and sharpening cornering.

climax.text: The Porsche 911's air-cooled flat-six became one of the most loved engine designs in history.

punchline.text: Laying an engine flat makes the whole car handle better.

quiz.question: Which brands are best known for flat (boxer) engines?
